title: Write unit tests for scaffold template-engine.ts
description: Create Vitest unit tests for the template-engine module. Test token replacement, binary file copying, nested directory creation, and unknown token handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Token replacement in text files test passes
Binary files are copied without modification test passes
Unknown {{TOKEN}} with no replacement value is left unchanged test passes
npm test passes all template-engine.test.ts cases

steps.details: Create the test file. Use beforeEach/afterEach to create/clean temp source and destination directories.
Create a temp file with content 'Hello {{NAME}}!'. Call processTemplate with vars { NAME: 'World' }. Verify output file contains 'Hello World!'.
Create a small binary file (e.g., a 1-byte .png header). Call processTemplate. Verify the output file is byte-for-byte identical to the input.

steps.description: Write nested directory and unknown token tests
steps.details: Create a nested src/deep/file.txt template. Verify processTemplate creates the nested output directory. Test with a template containing {{UNKNOWN}} and no matching var — verify the placeholder is left unchanged.
Run `npm test` and verify all template-engine.test.ts tests pass.
